name: threejs-shaders
title_zh: 在 Three.js 里直接写 GLSL 着色器做自
tagline_zh: 内置材质不够用？想改顶点、写片元、加 uniform？这个 skill 让你在 Three.js 里直接上手 GL。
tagline_en: Built-in materials not enough? Edit vertices, write fragment shaders, add uniforms — this skill gets you straight.
desc_en: Three.js shaders - GLSL, ShaderMaterial, uniforms, custom effects. Use when creating custom visual effects, modifying vertices, writing fragment shaders, or extending built-in materials.
why_zh: 它把 ShaderMaterial 的样板代码和常见 uniform 约定打包好。
why_en: It wraps ShaderMaterial boilerplate and common uniform conventions, so you focus on the GLSL core instead of re-building.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 的 ShaderMaterial 路径，不处理 post-processing 链。
limit_en: Only covers Three.js ShaderMaterial path — no post-processing chains, texture generation, or WebGL state tweaks. Beyond that, you're on your own.
